label: .liveAngleCommits
find: if let draft = cropDraft(angle: degrees) { cropDraft = draft }

label: .liveAngleLeavesCatalog
find: guard degrees.isFinite, let draft = cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
replace: guard let draft = cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }

label: .liveDragCommits
find: if let draft = cropDraft, let dragged = cropDraft(draft, dragging: handle, dx: dx, dy: dy) { cropDraft = dragged }

label: .liveDragFinite
find: guard dx.isFinite, dy.isFinite, cropDraft != nil, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
replace: guard cropDraft != nil, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
